item.title: Russia Destroys Underground Base of Ukraine's 'Magyar's* Birds' Unit in Kherson
item.summary: GENICHESK, Russia (Sputnik) - The Russian armed forces have carried out an airstrike destroy an underground Ukrainian military base that housed the "Magyar's* Birds" unit in the Ukraine-controlled part of the Kherson Region, a serviceman from the Russian Dnepr battlegroup told Sputnik.
